snippet.title: War Girl - Early Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
From the lovable bunch that brought you Khimera: Destroy all Monster  Girls is the platform shooter, War Girl!

A super early gameplay trailer from early development. A good idea of what the final game will look like but almost anything is subject to change!

Let us know what you think!
